verses.text: Listen, people of Israel, to this funeral song I sing about you:
"Israel, the young woman, has fallen, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her own land, with no one to lift her up."
This is what the Lord GOD says to Israel: "The city that sends out a thousand soldiers will have only a hundred left. The town that sends out a hundred will have only ten left."
This is what the LORD says to the people of Israel: "Look for me, and you will live.
Do not look for Bethel. Do not go to Gilgal or travel to Beersheba. The people of Gilgal will surely be taken away as captives, and Bethel will come to nothing."
Look for the LORD, and you will live. If you do not, he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire. It will burn up Bethel, and no one will be able to put it out.
You turn justice into something bitter and throw what is right to the ground.
He made the Pleiades and Orion. He turns darkness into morning and day into night. He calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the land. The LORD is his name.
He brings sudden destruction on the strong and destroys their fortified cities.
You hate anyone who stands up for justice in court, and you despise anyone who tells the truth.

You trample on the poor and force them to give you their grain. So even though you have built houses of cut stone, you will not live in them. Even though you have planted lovely vineyards, you will not drink their wine.
I know how many your crimes are and how great your sins are. You oppress honest people and take bribes. You keep the poor from getting justice in the courts.
So those who are wise keep quiet in times like these, because the times are evil.
Look for what is good, not what is evil, so that you may live. Then the LORD God of Armies will be with you, just as you claim he is.
Hate what is evil and love what is good. Make sure there is justice in the courts. Maybe the LORD God of Armies will show mercy to the survivors of Joseph.

So this is what the Lord, the LORD God of Armies, says: "There will be wailing in all the town squares and cries of grief in every street. Farmers will be called to weep, and professional mourners to wail.
There will be wailing in every vineyard, because I will pass through among you," says the LORD.
How terrible it will be for you who long for the day of the LORD! Why do you want the day of the LORD? It will be a day of darkness, not light.
It will be like a man who runs from a lion only to meet a bear, or like a man who goes into his house and leans his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.
Won't the day of the LORD be darkness instead of light, gloom without a ray of brightness?
"I hate and despise your religious festivals. I cannot stand your holy meetings.
Even if you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. I will not even look at the peace offerings of your fattened animals.
Take the noise of your songs away from me! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
Instead, let justice roll on like a river and doing right like a stream that never runs dry.
"People of Israel, did you bring me sacrifices and offerings during those forty years in the wilderness?
You have carried the shrine of your king and the stand of your idols, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
So I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
